gloss: respectfully (formal letter opening); Dear Sir or Madam

definitions.gloss: respectfully; with great respect (formal letter opening)
definitions.explanation: A highly formal opening phrase used at the beginning of a letter. Literally means 'I respectfully state.' Always paired with the closing {敬白|けいはく}.

examples.japanese: {謹啓|きんけい}　{時下|じか}ますますご{清栄|せいえい}のこととお{喜|よろこ}び{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます。
examples.english: Dear Sir/Madam, I trust you are enjoying continued prosperity.

examples.japanese: {正式|せいしき}な{文書|ぶんしょ}には{謹啓|きんけい}を{使|つか}う。
{結婚式|けっこんしき}の{招待状|しょうたいじょう}は{謹啓|きんけい}で{書|か}き{始|はじ}めるのが{一般的|いっぱんてき}だ。
examples.english: It is standard to begin wedding invitations with 'kinkei.'

notes:
The most formal of the standard letter-opening phrases. Composed of {謹|きん} (respectfully) and {啓|けい} (to state, to inform). Used in highly formal contexts such as wedding invitations, corporate announcements, and official correspondence. Must be paired with the closing {敬白|けいはく}.

LETTER OPENING/CLOSING PAIRS (by formality):
- {前略|ぜんりゃく} / {草々|そうそう}: informal
- {拝啓|はいけい} / {敬具|けいぐ}: standard formal
- {謹啓|きんけい} / {敬白|けいはく}: highly formal

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {拝啓|はいけい}: Dear Sir/Madam — the standard formal opening; less formal than {謹啓|きんけい}
- {前略|ぜんりゃく}: (dispensing with formalities) — a casual opening that skips the seasonal greeting
- {敬白|けいはく}: respectfully yours — the corresponding closing for {謹啓|きんけい}
